{"failure_class": "missing tool for a closing step",
 "root_cause": "The agent made the main update, then tried to add the call note with its plain text and the notes endpoint refused it with a 400: it wants the note base64url-encoded. The agent's last message says none of its tools adds a note to a contact from its plain text, given the contact id and the text, so it stopped. The only failed check is the note.",
 "mechanism": "A tool wrapper that takes the contact id and the plain note text, encodes the text base64url and posts it to the notes endpoint through the base API tool.",
 "component": "tools",
 "generality": "Every request that ends with a call note needs the same encoding step; a tool that takes plain text covers all of them, and the agent names exactly that interface as what it lacks."}
